Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. As discussed, we want a concise, low-friction path to get production observability wired into our Nexa Health inference pipelines before our Q4 pilot. Top-level asks: 

- Dashboard baseline (latency heatmap, tail latencies, model variant split).
- Tracing hooks for request metadata (customer_id, model_version, route) and a sample span naming convention.
- Error taxonomy + routing rules: how to triage model vs infra vs client errors, with suggested severity mapping.
- Runbook template for oncall + escalation steps (pager + SLO impact guidance).

Can you share your recommended runbook template and a short implementation sequence we can commit to? Our engineering team can allocate two engineers (named in CC) for the integration.

Attached: nexa_visibility_requirements.xlsx (xlsx) — internal priority matrix and sample traffic profile.

Chloe + Jessica —

Thanks — I pulled the spreadsheet and sketched an initial alert prioritization and error taxonomy below. This is an operational-first view so the runbook can reference it directly.

Proposed error taxonomy (short):
- CLASS: Model_Runtime_Error — e.g., logits explode / OOM at decode time. Severity: P1 if impacts >1% requests; otherwise P2. Action: immediate fallback to lighter variant + pager.
- CLASS: Inference_SLA_Error — e.g., tail latency breach (>99.9th percentile). Severity: P1 if rolling over 5min window and breach coincides with customer-impacting routes. Action: scale up pool / route to Dedicated.
- CLASS: Client_Input_Error — invalid schema / unsupported tool call. Severity: P3. Action: log + customer support ticket.
- CLASS: Infrastructure_Degradation — container crash, node reprovision. Severity: P1/P0 depending on redundancy. Action: SRE runbook.

Alert routing (initial):
- P0/P1 -> Pager duty (oncall SRE) + slack #prod-alerts + runbook link.
- P2 -> #cs-ops triage + email to CS owner; automatic ticket in Jira ENG-7321.
- P3 -> aggregated daily digest to Nexa support alias.

I’ll prepare a first pass of alert thresholds and a mapping doc in the Jira ticket. Also happy to join a short sync with Nexa eng this week to review the tracing keys.
